---

### Get it running

1. Download **TrackDeck.exe** below.
2. Install the [.NET 10 Desktop Runtime](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/10.0) if you don't have it yet.
3. Plug the keyboard in with the **USB cable** and close iCUE (check the tray, it hides).
4. Run TrackDeck and press play.

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `TrackDeck.exe` | The tray app. This is the one you want. |
| `trackdeck.icuewidget` | The same card as a widget for iCUE, for those who still run it. |
